MRN: [redacted ID]
REFERRING CLINICIAN: Dr. [redacted name]
DATE OF SAMPLE RECEIPT: [redacted date]
SAMPLE TYPE: Peripheral blood (EDTA)
LAB REFERENCE: [redacted ID]

ADMINISTRATIVE NOTIFICATION - SAMPLE RECEIPT

Dear Dr. [redacted name],

We acknowledge receipt of the above sample for mitochondrial DNA testing for MELAS (Mitochondrial Encephalomyopathy, Lactic Acidosis, and Stroke-like episodes) syndrome.

CURRENT STATUS:
• Sample received and accessioned
• DNA successfully extracted from peripheral blood
• DNA quality assessment: Satisfactory (A260/280 ratio: 1.85)
• DNA concentration: 125 ng/μL
• Sample stored at -80°C pending further processing

TEST REQUESTED:
Mitochondrial DNA analysis for MELAS-associated variants
- Full mitochondrial genome sequencing
- Heteroplasmy analysis
- Common MELAS mutations including m.3243A>G, m.3271T>C, m.3252A>G

IMPORTANT: CONSENT REQUIREMENT
Testing cannot proceed until appropriate genetic testing consent form is completed and received. Please ensure the consent form is completed by the patient's parent/guardian and returned to our laboratory at your earliest convenience.

The consent form should include:
- Authorization for mitochondrial DNA testing
- Understanding of potential findings
- Permission for sample storage
- Preferences regarding incidental findings

Once consent documentation is received, testing will be initiated with an expected turnaround time of 4-6 weeks.

DISCLAIMERS:
1. This notification does not constitute a clinical report
2. No genetic testing has been performed at this time
3. Results will only be issued following completion of authorized testing
4. This laboratory is accredited by [redacted organization] for molecular genetic testing
5. Testing will be performed according to current professional guidelines and standards

For questions regarding consent requirements or test status, please contact:
Genetic Counseling Services: [redacted phone]
Laboratory Customer Service: [redacted phone]

Sincerely,

[redacted name], PhD
Laboratory Director
[redacted name] Specialized Neurology Center
Molecular Genetics Laboratory
